title: Space Impact Evolution X
statusNote: The card installs and the app (caption "Space Impact", Athena.app) is launched, but it never draws: the frame count stays at 0 and /v1/screenshot answers 409 no_screen ("no active emulator surface"). At info level the log shows Athena.app, its .r01 resource file and the UI framework libraries loading (last ones: eikdlg, numbergrouping, phoneclient), then the read of System\Shareddata\100058ec.ini, and nothing more for 105 seconds: no panic, no thread kill, no reaction to keys.
notes: A plain Series 60 application rather than an N-Gage card title. It does not get as far as a picture in this emulator yet.
